_meta.datasheet_section: p.4 Package dimensions (bottom view + recommended footprint), drawing 6.550-5329.01-4 issue 5
_meta.package: SMD top-view 4 x 5 x 0.9±0.1 mm, 4 terminals + exposed pad
_meta.notes: Datasheet does not number pads; numbers are our footprint's. Bottom view: two cathode terminals on one short edge, anode + NC on the other (anode right, NC left in bottom view → anode left, NC right in top view). Exposed pad (cathode) and a tie bar are electrically cathode; recommended footprint has NO land for the exposed pad. Recommended lands 4 x (1.55 x 1.0), 4.1 x 5.2 overall, 1.0 gap. AEC-Q101, MSL 4.
